craft_notes: Sthāyin: transfer-joy. Close: indeed. Rejected: 'liberation-bound' — killed: going kept.

lines: So stands this moving-still world in the heart-seed;
who knows it truly — his is the freedom-going indeed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tathā hṛdayabījasthaṃ jagad etac carācaram | evaṃ yo vetti tattvena tasya nirvāṇagāminī

reads_against.argmap: So the moving-unmoving world stands in the heart-seed; who knows in truth: his, going-to-freedom.
